purpose: Accumulate raw collision neighborhoods around core/high-interest states without modifying established P1/P2 records.

policy.rule: Additional occurrences around an already-promoted target do not constitute independent physical evidence unless they are independently verified physical quantities.
policy.duplicate_namespace: Multiple CAS/DOI/article occurrences are counted for collision-density analysis but grouped by identifier namespace and source independence.
